description: This file defines the class Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterDefaultPluginHandler, which provides a method to register a default plugin handler in the Smarty templating engine. It includes class properties, a constructor, and a method for registering callbacks with error handling.

classes.name: Smarty_Internal_Method_RegisterDefaultPluginHandler
classes.description: Provides functionality to register a default plugin handler in Smarty templates.

methods.name: registerDefaultPluginHandler
methods.description: Registers a callback as the default plugin handler, throwing an exception if the callback is not callable.
